sources.entry: usage - macOS menu bar app that pins Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity CLI quota and burn rate to the screen, read from local session files.

summary.one_liner: usage is a macOS menu bar and Windows system tray app that shows Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok CLI, and Muse Code quota limits and reset countdowns on screen, with a terminal-only mode via uvx.
summary.what_it_does: It displays 5-hour (session) and weekly quota for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and Muse Code, plus Grok CLI's weekly credit, with reset countdowns and red coloring as a limit approaches. Token and cost figures for Claude Code, Codex, Grok CLI, and Muse Code are read from local log files, and Antigravity quota comes from its own CLI or Google's quota endpoint using the sign-in that CLI already stores. It can show Claude Code or Codex outage banners from their public status pages. A Claude Code status line hook adds context-window and prompt-cache warnings, and optional helpers such as a side pane, Token Saver, and Quota-Aware mode run inside Claude Code. It also produces HTML, CSV, and PNG token and cost reports, offers 16 panel themes, and provides a `usage status --json` output for scripts and tools like Starship or tmux.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code 5-hour and weekly usage limits
track Codex quota in the menu bar
see remaining AI coding quota before hitting a limit
report token usage and cost for AI coding tools
show AI quota in a Windows taskbar or tray
feed quota data into a shell prompt or tmux status bar
notable: Reads quota and cost from local session and log files rather than requiring a browser or login
Claude Code status line hook warns about bloated context and cold prompt cache
Optional Claude Code helpers: side pane, Token Saver, Beginner Mode, Quota-Aware Mode
Windows taskbar quota label and tray icon with selectable Claude or Codex source
Muse Code quota fetched by running a small background model call through its CLI
caveats: Menu bar and tray UI only on macOS 12+ and Windows 10/11; Linux has terminal interface only
Muse quota probe makes a real model call that uses a little Muse quota
Antigravity outage alerts not covered because it has no public status page
Claude Desktop quota reset times appear only when its local cache confirms them
keywords: see how close i am to my limit
